lexical_split.left: 🔴 PANEL 6C GIVES THE OTHER HALF, AND THE SIZE OF THE FLIP. In isolated calvarial osteoblasts the KO values relative to WT are Alp 0.655, Bsp 0.375, ColI 0.225, Oc 0.225 and RUNX2 0.295 — a 70% fall. So the SAME GENE in the SAME KNOCKOUT reads +50% in femur tissue and −70% in isolated osteoblasts from the same animals' calvaria. INFERENZA: this is a tissue-versus-cell-autonomous split, not a contradiction in the data. In bone the measurement includes recruitment — more osteoprogenitors entering the lineage to compensate for resorptive loss — while the isolated culture removes that systemic input and exposes the cell-intrinsic deficit. 🔴 THE CONSTRAINT THIS PLACES ON TRACK C, WRITTEN AS A CONSTRAINT AND NOT AS AN OBSERVATION: A NODE WHOSE SIGN CHANGES BETWEEN TISSUE AND ISOLATED CELL CANNOT CARRY A REPURPOSING HYPOTHESIS. In bone the measurement includes recruitment — more osteoprogenitors entering the lineage to compensate for resorptive loss — while the isolated culture removes that systemic input and exposes the cell-intrinsic deficit. 🔴 THE CONSTRAINT THIS PLACES ON TRACK C, WRITTEN AS A CONSTRAINT AND NOT AS AN OBSERVATION: A NODE WHOSE SIGN CHANGES BETWEEN TISSUE AND ISOLATED CELL CANNOT CARRY A REPURPOSING HYPOTHESIS. evidence.anchor: Figure 3, all five ITC panels; image retrieved from the CDN path embedded in the article HTML and held gitignored
evidence.snippet: [figure attestation - pixels cannot be quote-matched] Figure 3, five paired panels a-e. Upper panels: raw thermal power against time over roughly 80 minutes, showing injection spikes. Lower panels: molar heat against molar ratio from 0 to about 7.5, fitted with a solid line. Panels a (WBP1_PY1), c (WBP2_PY1) and d (WBP2_PY2) show near-horizontal traces between about −0.9 and −0.4 kcal/mol with no sigmoidal shape and shallow injection spikes. Panel b (WBP1_PY2) descends from about −1.9 to −0.6 kcal/mol, still curving at the highest molar ratio. Panel e (WBP2_PY3) descends from about −3.1 to −0.5 kcal/mol, also still curving at the highest molar ratio, with the deepest injection spikes of the set reaching about −2 μcal/s.

lexical_split.left: 🔴 THE ITC ISOTHERMS DO NOT REACH SATURATION, WHICH QUALIFIES EVERY NUMBER IN TABLES 1 AND 5 AND IS INVISIBLE IN THE TEXT. This is the panel finding the figure waiver cost, and it is exactly the residual risk that waiver named. THE THREE NBD PANELS ARE HONEST: WBP1_PY1, WBP2_PY1 and WBP2_PY2 give essentially flat heat traces, so 'no binding detected' is what the raw data show rather than a fitting choice. BUT THE TWO BINDING PANELS ARE SHALLOW: WBP1_PY2 runs from about −1.9 to −0.6 kcal/mol and WBP2_PY3 from about −3.1 to −0.5, and NEITHER HAS FLATTENED at the highest molar ratio shown, about 7.5. A titration that has not saturated is a low-c experiment in the Wiseman sense, and in that regime the fitted stoichiometry and the dissociation constant are correlated and weakly determined. 🔴 AND THE LOW-c DIAGNOSIS MUST NOT REST ON CURVE SHAPE ALONE — IT IS ARITHMETIC FROM THE PAPER'S OWN METHODS. The Methods state 25 × 10 μl injections of 2-4 mM peptide into 1.8 ml of 100-200 μM WW domain at 25 °C, so for a 1:1 interaction c = [domain]/Kd falls in a RANGE rather than at a point, because the concentration used in any single titration is not reported: WW1 alone with WBP1_PY2 (366 μM) gives c ≈ 0.27-0.55; WW1 alone with WBP2_PY3 (122 μM) gives c ≈ 0.82-1.64. Both are at or below the threshold where an isotherm is informative about stoichiometry. THE TANDEM MEASUREMENTS ARE BETTER PLACED AND THIS CUTS IN THEIR FAVOUR: the WT tandem with WBP2_PY3 (49 μM) gives c ≈ 2.04-4.08, and the engineered WW1-WW2rw with WBP2_PY3 (59 μM) gives c ≈ 1.69-3.39 — low, but not the regime where n is unrecoverable. The remaining tandem titrations sit lower: WT with WBP1_PY2 (132 μM) c ≈ 0.76-1.52 and with WBP2_PY2 (326 μM) c ≈ 0.31-0.61. CONSEQUENCE, STATED AS THE OPERATOR
lexical_split.right: the ±1 μM on a 122 μM Kd is the scatter of three fits and not the accuracy of the determination. AND THE ENGINEERED CONTROL DOES NOT 'PROTECT' n = 1.05 NOR DEMONSTRATE ITS ACCURACY ON ITS OWN — it CORROBORATES that the fit can discriminate one binding capacity from two under comparable conditions, which is a weaker and correct statement.

lexical_split.left: 🔴 THE SIGNIFICANCE AXIS OF THE ONLY MOLECULAR FIGURE CANNOT BE MAPPED ONTO ANY STATED THRESHOLD. The y-axis of both volcano plots is labelled '-Log10 adjusted differential value p'. Read literally, the dashed threshold line sits at about 0.83 on that axis, i.e. p around 0.15, and the most extreme point in either panel reaches about 1.4, i.e. p around 0.04 — meaning that across 9,404 and 9,318 variables not one gene would reach p<0.04. That is not a credible p-value distribution for a transcriptome comparison. The Methods do not resolve it: they say significance came from the NOISeq-sim algorithm, and NOISeq's statistic is a PROBABILITY of differential expression whose conventional cut is 0.8, not a p-value — and 0.8 is almost exactly where the threshold line sits. But values above 1.0 appear in both panels, which a probability cannot take. So the axis is consistent with neither reading, and the Discussion's phrase 'significantly reduced expression' rests on a criterion that the paper does not let a reader reconstruct. This is a PREMISE_TAG on everything

A linear protein schematic numbered 1 to 414, blocks left to right: WW1 (orange), a yellow block with a yellow arrow labelled 'NLS', WW2 (green), a blue region, a teal block with a teal arrow labelled 'NADP', 'N' (blue), 'MTS' (orange to yellow), 'Loop' (grey), a red block with a red arrow labelled 'Catalytic Site', 'Central' (teal), 'C' (cream). A bracket underneath spans from the NADP region to the Central block, labelled 'SRD DOMAIN'. Variant lollipops above the bar include p.D16STer, p.E17K, p.W44Ter, p.P47R, p.R54Ter, p.G137E, p.H150P, p.H173Ter, p.Q230P, p.L239R, then p.R264Ter drawn in RED at the right-hand edge of MTS, then p.K297Ter, p.S304P, p.S318L, p.W335Ter. lexical_split.left: 🔴 WHERE THE STOP CODON FALLS, READ OFF THE DOMAIN MAP, AND IT IS THE DETAIL THAT SEPARATES THE TWO ARMS. In panel 1G, p.R264Ter is drawn in red at the C-terminal boundary of the MTS
lexical_split.right: immediately before the grey 'Loop' and the red 'Catalytic Site'. So a truncation at residue 264 of 414 would RETAIN WW1, the NLS, WW2, the NADP site and the ENTIRE mitochondrial targeting sequence, and would remove only the loop, the catalytic site, the Central block and the C-terminus. INFERENZA: if the transcript escapes NMD, the product is not an absence of Wwox but a catalytically dead Wwox that can still be delivered to mitochondria and still present both WW domains to PPXY partners. Absence and a dead-but-present interactor are different diseases mechanistically and different problems therapeutically - one cannot be stabilised, the other might not want to be. The paper's disjunction hides this because both arms are called 'loss of normal function'.

lexical_split.right: GROUP UNDER A CONDITION THE PAPER NEVER SHOWS FOR THE MEASURES IT POOLS. The rule is declared and it is conditional. But Table 1 marks the heterozygote as significantly different from wild type on FOUR intrinsic properties — action-potential amplitude, input resistance, resting membrane potential and sag — and the S-CTL pooling is nonetheless used for the entire spontaneous-current analysis of Figure 4E-H. evidence.anchor: Figure 2 panels B, D and E
evidence.snippet: [figure attestation - pixels cannot be quote-matched] Figure 2, panels B, D and E. B: sleep profile in 30-minute bins across ZT0-24, grey w1118 and olive Wwox-f04545, dark phase shaded from ZT12; the grey trace shows a daytime siesta peak near 30 min per bin around ZT5-8 that the olive trace does not reach, and in the shaded night both traces sit near 30 min per bin until roughly ZT20 after which the GREY trace declines toward 20-25 while the olive stays at ceiling. D: activity in beam counts per 30 min on the same axis; both genotypes show a morning peak near ZT0-1 of roughly 110 and 95 counts, and an evening peak at ZT11-12 where GREY reaches about 100 and OLIVE only about 60. lexical_split.left: 🔴 AND THE FIGURE'S OWN TITLE CLAIMS MORE THAN ITS PANEL D SUPPORTS. Figure 2 is titled 'Deletion of Wwox changed sleep duration WITHOUT AFFECTING THE CIRCADIAN RHYTHM', and the evidence offered for the second half is panel E: free-running period and rhythmicity are equivalent, 23.5 h and 96.9% against 96.7%. But panel D shows the mutant's EVENING ACTIVITY PEAK MARKEDLY BLUNTED — the
lexical_split.right: rises to roughly 100 beam counts per 30 min at ZT11-12 where the mutant reaches about 60 — while the morning peak is far more similar. In Drosophila that evening rise is anticipatory behaviour driven by the clock's evening oscillator, and IT CAN BE LOST WITH AN INTACT FREE-RUNNING PERIOD: period measures the pacemaker, anticipation measures its coupling to behaviour. INFERENZA: 'without affecting the circadian rhythm' is supported for the pacemaker and not for its output, and the two are different claims wearing one phrase. Panel B agrees — the night-time gain is not uniform but concentrated in the late night, where controls become active and mutants do not.

Reduced activity WITH reduced daytime sleep looked incoherent to me — in Drosophila sleep is defined as five minutes without beam crossings, so less activity ought to mean more scored sleep. Short, broken activity

evidence.anchor: Results, opening paragraph; the allele frequency is in Table 1
evidence.snippet: This mutation was absent in 100 healthy pediatric controls, suggesting its potential pathogenicity

lexical_split.left: 🔴 THE
lexical_split.right: COHORT IS ROUGHLY TWENTY-FIVE TIMES TOO SMALL TO MEAN WHAT IT IS SAID TO MEAN, AND THE ARITHMETIC IS THE PAPER'S OWN. Absence in 100 healthy controls is offered as evidence of pathogenicity. The paper also reports the gnomAD allele frequency as 2.04e-4. One hundred people carry 200 alleles, so the EXPECTED NUMBER OF CARRIERS IN THAT COHORT IS 200 × 2.04e-4 = 0.04. Finding the variant absent is precisely what would happen for ANY variant this rare, pathogenic or benign — the observation has no power to discriminate. PREMISE_TAG: PREMISE: DEFAULT_FROM_TEXTBOOK — 'absent in controls means pathogenic' is the unstated rule, and it is false at this cohort size. This is checkable in one multiplication from two numbers printed in the same paper.

evidence.anchor: Section 4, the paragraph on Lucas-Clarke et al. 2025 (preprint)
evidence.snippet: lowers L-methionine and suppresses methionine metabolism

lexical_split.left: A METABOLIC AXIS WITH A SIGNED DIRECTION AND A DISSOCIATED RESCUE, IN DROSOPHILA AND IN A PREPRINT. Wwox loss
lexical_split.right: increased lactate production and elevated lactate dehydrogenase, via the ATF4 branch of the unfolded protein response and independent of HIF1α. Neuronal Wwox overexpression by CRISPR activation restores lifespan and motor function and reduces amyloid accumulation — and 🔴 does NOT reduce lactate, lowering L-methionine and suppressing methionine metabolism instead. So the marker that moves with the lesion is not the marker that moves with the rescue: lactate would be a biomarker that reports the genotype and not the treatment. ESPANSIONE — Drosophila, an Aβ42 model, and Lucas-Clarke et al. 2025 is a preprint. Its value is that it separates a lesion marker from a response marker, which is a distinction this repository's biomarker layer makes structurally and rarely gets to see demonstrated.

SOX2+ cells fall from about 60 percent in the knockout to about 33 with A51, ns against wild type; SOX2+MYC+ double positives from about 72 to about 50, ns against wild type; NEUN+ neurons recover from about 6 percent to about 18, significant against the untreated knockout and ns against wild type. But SATB2+ shows ns between knockout and A51, and CTIP2+ shows ns between knockout and A51 while remaining **** below wild type. So inhibiting MYC restores progenitor identity and pan-neuronal marking, and leaves deep- and superficial-layer neuron production where it was. Any claim that MYC inhibition rescues neurogenesis has to carry that split — and the compound is in any case not MYC-selective.
